_comment: Regional sites the off-page checks add to the industry profile's lists (industry_profiles.json).
review     OFF-05 and OFF-06: review and rating sites.
profile    OFF-03: business directories and company-profile sites.
community  OFF-07: discussion sites, searched alongside any URL containing 'forum' or 'community'.
Sites are bare domains (trustpilot.com, not https://www.trustpilot.com/). A longer list does not lower
a score: full presence marks need `platforms_for_full_marks` sites found (scoring_rules.json), whichever
sites of the active list those are. OFFPAGE_PLATFORMS_PATH points the app at a different file.
